films.$comment: Collabora-SING is a product in development, not one of the nine. `exclusive` keeps this film to the pages in `placement` and off /films (the build fails if any other page carries it). `sound: none` and `textTrack: descriptions`: the film is silent, so captions.vtt holds one cue that says so, and descriptions.vtt describes what is shown and quotes the on-screen words (the page prints the same text under the player). `burnedLabel` is burned into the web rendition and its posters for the whole duration (founder, 2026-11-10: the labelling of figures must be in the film, not only beside it), on a 56 px band added above the picture so that it covers nothing and the player's controls never cover it: the rendition differs from the master by that band, the 720p scale and the absent silent audio stream, and by nothing else; the master is untouched. `frame` is the rendition's size with the band. `qualifier` is also printed directly above the player at all times, because the film's own disclaimers are on screen only briefly (its figures sit under a "MEASURED" chip, its last labels turn to "MEASURED", and its end card has no qualifier). `source.captions` and `source.descriptions` are those two files, kept in the repository; `source.video` is the master under the production root.

burnedLabel.text: IN DEVELOPMENT · DEMONSTRATION DATA · NO PILOT HAS BEEN RUN

films.summary: The research plan behind Collabora-SING, in eight short scenes: a hypothesis, two ways to send one performance, five network conditions, a player at a keyboard, a blind test, telemetry, an analyzer, and what is not yet measured.
